label_replace(sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance="$instance",service=~"$service",code=~"5.."}[$__range])) / sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance="$instance",service=~"$service"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance="$instance",service=~"$service"}[$__range])), "service", "$1", "service", "([^@]+?)(?:-docker)?@.*")
